goal: For each card in tasks.py stale: read git log over its scope paths since the refresh stamp, decide if the card text still holds, then python scripts/dev/tasks.py tag <id> --refresh; a card whose scope really moved gets its fields fixed or is parked with tasks.py tried.

steps: Run tasks.py stale and group cards by the commit that moved their scope (many share one commit, e.g. a702fafd, 494b4ad0).
Per group read the commit's diff on the scope paths; if the card goal still stands run tasks.py tag <id> --refresh.
If not, edit the card (goal, steps, scope_in) and re-run tasks.py check; otherwise tasks.py tried with a note.
